name: Living Battery

parts.label: Innate
parts.text:
Innate: Zeri generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts Burst Fire, up to a maximum of 100 charge. Her basic attacks consume charge to deal modified damage.
Zeri gains maximum charge when the game starts and upon respawning.

Basic Attack: Zeri zaps the target, dealing 10 – 25 (based on level) (+ 3% AP) magic damage, applying spell effects as spell damage, triggering on-cast effects and executing the target if they are below 70 – 160 (based on level) (+ 20% AP) health. This cannot critically strike and does not apply nor trigger on-hit and on-attack effects.

Uncharged attacks do not execute enemies that are shielded or invulnerable while below the health threshold.
Spell shield will only block a fully charged attack. Uncharged attacks are not blocked.
The attack's range is affected by attack range modifiers (Rapid Firecannon) (tested on patch 26.12).

Attacking a turret does not consume Crystalline Overgrowth.
The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against wards or jungle plants.
If Last Hit Indicator enabled, it will indicate Living Battery's execute threshold instead of its usual function.

name: Burst Fire

values.label: Empowered spray missile speed while Overcharged
Angle at which the outermost missiles fan out from one another, 2.5 degree from the center

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Zeri fires a burst of 7 rounds in the target direction over the cast time, each dealing physical damage to the first enemy hit.

Burst Fire's projectile is treated as a basic attack: it hits any enemy unit a typical basic attack can; deals basic damage; can critically strike for 200% damage; and applies on-hit and on-attack effects to the first enemy hit. Burst Fire's cooldown and cast time are reduced with attack speed, with the maximum of 1.5 attacks per second. 60% of attack speed in excess of the cap is converted into bonus attack damage.

notes: Burst Fire is automatically learned with her first skill point upon spawning.
Burst Fire deals basic damage and does not trigger spell effects. It is additionally tagged as area of effect when damaging targets after the first.

Burst Fire is still locked out while Zeri is affected by any form of other cast-inhibiting crowd control.
  - Silence is special cased to specifically not disable Burst Fire.
  - Polymorph, despite functioning identically to silence, will still lock Burst Fire from being cast.

Any of Burst Fire's rounds hitting a champion will draw minion aggro, regardless of whether or not other targets were hit first by Burst Fire's rounds.
  - A lightning chain from a Lightning Crash empowered Burst Fire will not draw minion aggro.
Casting Burst Fire does not cancel previous attack (Living Battery) and movement orders.
Burst Fire does not trigger Tear of the Goddess Mana Charge.
Burst Fire's cooldown is not reduced by Navori Flickerblade Transcendence.

Tantrum, Nimble Fighter, and Eclipse flat damage reduction apply to each of the 7 instances of damage from Burst Fire.
  - Warden's Mail flat damage reduction and cap only apply to the first instance of damage.
  - Guardian's Horn flat damage reduction only applies to the first instance of damage, but handles it as damage-over-time (reduced to 25% effectiveness).

Burst Fire still counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as triggering Force Pulse passive.
  - It does not count as an ability activation for Spellblade.

Burst Fire can hit all enemy units that a basic attack would be able to target. This does include jungle plants, structures, and wards.
  - Wards will only be hit once by Burst Fire. Stealthed wards and traps will not take damage.
    - Burst Fire will still apply on-attack effects to stealthed traps and wards.
    - Neeko will be hit multiple times while disguised as a ward, but any subsequent rounds will continue to travel through.
  - Champion-summoned units behave differently depending on the unit.
    - Powder Keg and Dark Procession are hit only once by Burst Fire, and any subsequent rounds not empowered by Spark Surge will stop upon reaching the same object.
    - Sentinel is hit only once by Burst Fire, but any subsequent rounds will continue to travel through the Sentinel.
If Burst Fire hits an enemy while Zeri is not visible to enemies, the area around her (400 units) will be revealed for 4.5 seconds.
Burst Fire rolls critical strike for all rounds as well as the additional physical damage dealt when Zeri is Overcharged.

Burst Fire is parried by dodge and block.
  - Blind causes Burst Fire to cast in a random direction. The rounds will still deal damage to enemies hit.
Burst Fire's rounds are each fired in the target direction from where Zeri is at the time.

Only attack speed granted by being Overcharged can exceed the cap of 1.5.
  - Hail of Blades does not allow Zeri to exceed her attack speed cap.
Item and rune effects that trigger off of attacking (e.g., Fleet Footwork and Kraken Slayer) will only trigger if Burst Fire hits a unit.
If Zeri would reach maximum Energized stacks from a Burst Fire cast, the remaining rounds will trigger Energized's effect.
Burst Fire's cast-indicator does not show range increases; modified range VFX are still visible around the champion model.
Burst Fire can apply the effect of Horizon Focus when the enemy hit is within the last 50 units of this ability.
Burst Fire uses a modified icon when empowered by Spark Surge () and Lightning Crash () as well as both ().

Destroying a ward that is targetable but not visible to Zeri's team (e.g. a Control Ward in Fog of War) via Burst Fire uniquely allows her to remove its accompanying ward timer (if it exists) without seeing the ward being destroyed.
If Zeri is affected by an ally Tempered Fate during Burst Fire's cast time, she will be able to cast it during the effect.

The bonus AD calculates off of excess bonus attack speed percent - not the raw excess attack speed.
  - For example, if she has 150% bonus attack speed percent, but needs only 135% to reach the 1.5 attack speed cap, she will gain 0.6 × (150−135)0.6 × 159 AD
  - The excess attack speed is calculated after any cripple effects (like Frozen Heart Winter's Caress), meaning they can reduce both her attack speed and attack damage.
  - The excess attack speed is calculated before Lightning Crash applies its effects. Using it won't change the attack damage, despite her gaining additional attack speed and the cap changing.

name: Lightning Crash

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Zeri discharges an electric nova that deals magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters Overcharged for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or charged attack will extend the duration by 2.5 seconds, up to its original duration.

parts.label: Overcharged
parts.text: Overcharged: Zeri gains 15% bonus movement speed and 30% bonus attack speed and an increased attack speed cap of 1.6875. Burst Fire is empowered to have a 20% shorter cast time and a decreased spread angle, and instead fires 3 rounds that travel with increased speed. The first round to hit an enemy per cast instance chains electricity to the nearest visible enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal 40% AD physical damage. This damage can critically strike for 40% AD bonus physical damage.

mechanics.evidence: The first round to hit an enemy per cast instance chains electricity to the nearest visible enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal 40% AD physical damage.
This damage can critically strike for 40% AD bonus physical damage.

values.context: Overcharged: Zeri gains 15% bonus movement speed and 30% bonus attack speed and an increased attack speed cap of 1.6875.

parts.text: During Overcharged, Zeri can generate stacks of Hypercharged from enemy champions that last 2.5 seconds. She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or charged attack, increased to 3 on abilities that critically strike. Subsequent hits refresh the duration of Hypercharged. Burst Fire grants stacks only against the first target hit.

mechanics.evidence: She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or charged attack, increased to 3 on abilities that critically strike.

parts.label: Hypercharged
parts.text: Hypercharged: For each stack, Zeri gains 1.5% bonus movement speed.
Zeri can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.

notes: Lightning Crash does not interrupt Zeri's previous orders.
Zeri can stack Hypercharged up to 100,000 times.
Applies area damage for the nova and proc damage for the chain lightning.

Spell shield blocks Lightning Crash's initial nova but does not prevent Zeri from becoming Overcharged.
  - It does not block Burst Fire electricity chain.
Clones count for granting Overcharge.
Lightning Crash's and Spark Surge empowerments to Burst Fire can combine together.
Burst Fire electricity chain will not chain across structures.

Entering resurrection causes Zeri to lose all stacks of Hypercharged.
  - Overcharged is not removed, however.
  - Zeri will not be able to gain stacks of Hypercharged again after reviving while Overcharged is active.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.

name: Ultrashock Laser

parts.label: Active
parts.text:
Active: Zeri fires an electric pulse in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and slows them for 2 seconds.

If the pulse hits terrain, it transforms into a laser in a line that grants sight of the area for 1.75 seconds and fires after 0.85 seconds, applying the same effects to enemies hit and critically striking for 150% damage against champions and monsters.
